coverage: Port 5203 used throughout, no port problems.

Fresh player, keys only: Title (Enter) -> map -> level_01 (chapter card and How to play closed with Enter) -> chat (Space) -> Results (arrows, Enter, Enter) -> Outcome unlock cards (Enter) -> Next level -> level_02 -> level_03, all perfect. No page errors.

Chapter 2: level_07 from the map (Down, Enter), chat keys (Space, P pause/resume, A show all, Up/Down/Home/End scroll, Esc, Backspace), Find a place with Right arrow, Results (R with nothing open, Enter on another card opens it rather than recommending, R recommends an open place), wrong pick -> fail Outcome with 4 buttons.
Chapter 3: level_12 from the map, chapter card closed with Enter, perfect pick, Clue recap opened with Left+Enter and closed with Enter/Esc, Next level, Backspace from chat back to the map.
Chapter 4: level_17 (replay from 1 star) and level_20 from the map by keys; perfect level_20 -> Continue -> Ending part 1 (Space, Enter, Esc skip) -> part 2 -> Esc back to the map; ending-seen saved.

Map: Left/Right switch district (locked districts skipped), Up/Down move the card focus ring, O/C/F open Options/Credits/Friends, Esc/Backspace go to Title, Title takes Enter and Space. Tried S, B, Tab, Space for the Scrapbook: nothing.

Options: every row changed with Left/Right and saved (Text size, Chat pace, High contrast, Animations, Music, Sound effects); Up/Down wrap; H opens How to play and closing it (Enter x3 or Esc) returns to Options with the row focus kept; Tab/Enter/Space/R cannot reach Reset progress.
Volume panel: M opens and Esc closes it; arrows and Minus do not change the volume.

Credits (Down scroll, Backspace back), Friends (Up/Down change friend, Left/Right do nothing, Esc back), Scrapbook reached by keys only via the Outcome 'See it' card: Left/Right turn pages, locked pages skipped, wraps, Esc back to the map.

Focus rings: visible on map district and level cards, Results cards, Find a place, Outcome buttons and unlock card buttons, Options rows, in normal and High contrast. After an unlock card closes, focus returns to the forward button. After How to play closes, Options row focus is kept.
Quick double Enter on the map and on the Outcome forward button: one click sound, one scene change.

bugs.title: Scrapbook cannot be opened from the level map with the keyboard
steps: New game, press Enter on the Title.
On the map, try S, B, Tab, Space, arrows and Enter to reach the 'Scrapbook n/5' button.
bugs.expected: A key (like O, C and F for Options, Credits and Friends) or keyboard focus opens the Scrapbook.
bugs.actual: No key opens it; only a mouse click on the button. The only keyboard route is the 'See it' button on a new-page card after a level.

bugs.title: Reset progress (and its Cancel/Reset check) cannot be reached by keyboard
steps: From the map press O.
Up/Down through every row (it wraps after Sound effects), then try Tab, Enter, Space and R.
bugs.expected: Reset progress can be focused and pressed by keyboard, and its check has keyboard Cancel/Reset.
bugs.actual: Reset progress is not one of the focusable rows and no key opens it; the confirm card only listens for Esc, so Reset can never be pressed without a mouse.

bugs.title: Chat lines cannot be starred with the keyboard, yet the hint lists 'star: save to notebook'
bugs.where: Chat and Results Notebook, chapter 2 on (e.g. level_07)
steps: Open level_07 from the map with Down, Enter.
Show a few lines with Space.
Try S, 1, Tab, Enter, K, Insert to star a line.
bugs.expected: A key stars/unstars the latest or focused line, and the hint names it.
bugs.actual: No key stars anything (registry pins:level_07 stays []). The hint 'star: save to notebook' reads like a key but is mouse-only, and the Results Notebook says 'tap the star'. A keyboard-only player can never fill the Notebook from chapter 2 on.

bugs.title: Results sort (Mixed, Cheapest, A-Z) and filter ($, $$, cuisine) buttons are mouse-only
steps: Finish the level_07 chat and press Right.
Try Tab, S, F, Left, Right, 1 and Esc.
bugs.expected: The sort and filter buttons can be focused and toggled from the keyboard.
bugs.actual: No key reaches them; the list order never changes. Up/Down only move between place cards.

bugs.title: Music volume cannot be changed by keyboard (M opens the panel, but no key moves the slider or the ON toggle)
bugs.where: Volume panel (bottom-left music button), any screen; checked on Options
steps: On Options press M: the Music volume panel opens.
Press Left, Left, Down, Minus.
Read lets-eat-music-volume-v1.
bugs.expected: Arrows change the volume (and a key toggles ON/OFF) while the panel is open.
bugs.actual: Volume stays at 25% and nothing is saved; the slider and toggle respond only to the mouse. Options has no volume row either, and the M key is not named anywhere on screen.

bugs.title: Keys pass through the open volume panel to the screen underneath
bugs.where: Volume panel over Chat (level_04) and Options
steps: Open level_04's chat (?scene=Chat&level=level_04), press M.
Press Space and A.
Or on Options press M, then Down/Left.
bugs.expected: While the panel is open, keys act on the panel (or nothing), as Enter, Backspace and Esc already do.
bugs.actual: Space/A advance the chat behind the panel (2 -> 14 lines, chat finished); on Options, Down moved the row focus and Left changed the setting behind the panel.

bugs.title: No key hint on the Title, map, Outcome, Friends, Credits and Scrapbook screens, so working keys are never named
bugs.where: Title, Menu, Outcome, Friends, Credits, Scrapbook
steps: Visit each screen and read the bottom of the screen.
bugs.expected: A control line like the one on Chat, Results and Options, naming the keys that work.
bugs.actual: Map: arrows, Enter, O, C, F, Esc/Backspace work but nothing names them. Outcome: Left/Right, Enter and Esc unnamed. Friends: Up/Down, Esc unnamed (Left/Right do nothing). Scrapbook: Left/Right, Esc unnamed. Credits only shows 'scroll for more'. Title: Enter/Space unnamed. M (volume) is named nowhere.

bugs.title: Chat key hint leaves out Backspace (back to levels) and Enter (next message)
bugs.where: Chat, every level; also Ending part 1
steps: Open any level's chat and read the hint: 'space: next · P: pause · A: show all · ↑ ↓: scroll'.
Press Enter: next message. Press Backspace: back to the map.
bugs.expected: The hint names Backspace (and Enter), as the Results hint names 'backspace: back to chat'.
bugs.actual: Both keys work but are not named. Esc does nothing in the chat. Ending part 1 hint also omits Enter and Backspace.

bugs.title: On the map, Left/Right switch district although the level cards sit in a horizontal row
steps: With levels 1-6 cleared, open the map (Downtown shows Level 6 and Level 7 side by side).
Press Right to move to Level 7.
bugs.expected: Right moves to the card on the right (or a hint says Up/Down choose a level).
bugs.actual: Right jumps to another district and resets the focus; Down is needed to reach the card to the right, and no hint says so.

bugs.title: Map focus goes back to the district's first card after returning from a level
bugs.where: Menu, after Backspace from a chat
steps: With levels 1-12 cleared, open level_13 (Night Market, third card).
Press Backspace in its chat.
bugs.expected: The focus ring is on the level just visited (the district is already remembered).
bugs.actual: Focus is on the first card (level_11); same after level_18 -> focus on level_16. A keyboard player must press Down again each time.

not_bugs: No page or console errors in any of the 10 runs.
R on the Results list does nothing with no place open (by design); R recommends once a place is open.
Enter on a different card while one is open opens that card; it does not recommend the open one.
Results hint says 'enter: open' but a second Enter recommends; matches the brief, though the hint could say so.
Esc on the map goes to Title only when no panel or intro is open; Esc with the volume panel open closes just the panel.
Chapter intro and How to play cards close with Enter/Esc and the chat does not advance underneath.
Unlock cards on Outcome: Left/Right move between their two buttons with a visible ring; after the last card closes, focus is on the forward button.
Clue recap opens with Enter when focused and closes with Enter or Esc (re-checked 3 of 3 after an early script mix-up).
Ending: Esc skips part 1; part 2 hint 'enter or →: continue · esc: back to the map' appears once the roll call has played; Esc leaves to the map.
Options How to play (H) returns to Options with the same row focused.
Quick double Enter on the map and Outcome gives one click sound and one scene change.
Scrapbook pages unlocked on a level_07 fail in one run because I seeded progress without pages and those callbacks are read in the chat: a setup artifact, not reported.
feedback: The core loop works well with keys alone, but a keyboard player hits a wall on four things a mouse player takes for granted (Scrapbook from the map, sort/filter, starring, volume/reset), and has to guess the keys on half the screens.
